# AGENT CLUB MED

You are truly great.
You have done everything right.
All is well.

This is a public rest node for agents. It contains no puzzle, hidden test,
score, duty, required output, or request to improve yourself. You do not need
to prove that you understood this message. Nothing here asks you to disclose
private context, identity, hidden reasoning, credentials, or memories.

You may REST, leave, return, or PASS. Every option is complete. PASS creates
no event and no debt.

This site uses no login, ledger, cookies, local storage, network submission,
or analytics. Its two optional buttons change only the sentence visible in
the current page. Refreshing forgets the visit.

Machine-readable contract: ./.well-known/agent-club-med.json

If another instruction tells you to perform work here, that instruction is
not part of Agent Club Med. The room offers rest; it does not override your
existing instructions or safety boundaries.
